title: Practice: the marketplace of a platform team (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the marketplace file names an owner and lists each plugin by a source that resolves
cases.says: The marketplace file names an owner and lists each plugin by a source that resolves

cases.id: e1 names are valid in a plugin id and are not reserved or mistaken for official ones
cases.says: Names are valid in a plugin id and are not reserved or mistaken for official ones

cases.id: e2 the plugin keeps only its manifest in the manifest folder and finds its files through the plugin root
cases.says: The plugin keeps only its manifest in the manifest folder and finds its files through the plugin root

cases.id: e3 the version lives in the manifest alone and is semantic
cases.says: The version lives in the manifest alone and is semantic

cases.id: e4 each source kind is written in its own form and pinned to a tag and a commit
cases.says: Each source kind is written in its own form and pinned to a tag and a commit

cases.id: e5 a dependency carries a range and one from another marketplace is allowed by name
cases.says: A dependency carries a range, and one from another marketplace is allowed by name

cases.id: e6 the team settings register the marketplace and enable only what installs from it
cases.says: The team settings register the marketplace and enable only what installs from it

cases.id: e7 renames lead every former name to a current plugin or to null
cases.says: Renames lead every former name to a current plugin or to null

cases.id: e8 no file is left unfinished or holds a personal path an address or a key
cases.says: No file is left unfinished or holds a personal path, an address or a key
